title: CR-C3-019 — Invoicing + AP/AR
preconds: Permissions (counted): Customers V + Vendors V and Order Management V + Invoicing V+E + See AP/AR. Auto-gate forced ON (not counted): See Fin. View Mode: Full unless noted. All other permissions OFF.
steps:
1. Create a custom role with the permissions listed in Preconditions; leave all others OFF.
  2. Assign the role to a test user and log in.
  3. Exercise each capability in Expected Result and confirm it succeeds (and that gated pricing is hidden where noted).
expected:
User CAN: Process payments; Use Deposits and Credits for paying invoices; Create Credits; send to terminal; Invoices/Payments/Deposits tabs (for customer & for vendor without deposits tab); bulk payments from Unpaid Invoices tab

Risk / Rationale: Positive capability check — confirms this combination grants exactly the listed actions and nothing gated leaks.
Spec Ref: §1h+§5b
